This role leads the technical team through complex diagnostics, oversee end-to-end procurement and inventory control, and optimizes workflow processes from job initiation to vehicle delivery. By managing resources, controlling costs, and enforcing HSE compliance, the Service Center Team Leader ensures operational continuity, team capability, and exceptional customer satisfaction. Lead, plan, and direct daily workshop operations, supervising mechanical, electrical, and technical repair activities across fleet and customer vehicles to maintain operational workflow continuity. Plan and oversee preventive maintenance schedules, ensuring all vehicles are serviced, repaired, and delivered on time to meet agreed delivery dates and fleet availability targets. Design, implement, and oversee internal systems for workshop repair order processing and spare parts inventory management, ensuring accuracy, traceability, and efficient workflow control. Establish and enforce high repair quality standards, leading thorough diagnostic evaluations for complex mechanical or electrical issues, providing innovative solutions to minimize rework and repeat repairs. Maintain equipment assets, workshop tools, and facility machinery, ensuring routine maintenance, proper usage, calibration, and operational safety. Monitor vehicle performance trends, fuel efficiency metrics, and maintenance logs, verifying that all fleet vehicles meet company standards, national regulatory and safety requirements. Deliver assigned workshop revenue targets, labor sales, margin performance, and key performance indicators (KPIs) through effective resource utilization and job costing controls. Oversee real-time service completion and vehicle availability by continuously tracking daily workflow and productivity rates. Supervise, allocate tasks to, and direct foremen, technicians, and workshop support staff based on skill specializations and daily workload priorities. Coordinate rapid-response protocols for emergency roadside breakdowns, dispatching mobile repair units to minimize fleet downtime and restore operational availability. Drive targeted cost-control initiatives including operational savings and overhead reductions across workshop materials, utilities, labor, consumables, and maintenance expenses. Manage workshop productivity, labor allocation, bay capacity utilization, and vehicle throughput to optimize overall operational efficiency and eliminate service bottlenecks. Oversee the end-to-end procure-to-pay and inventory workflow for spare parts, managing stock levels, requisition approvals, and parts distribution to control maintenance costs. Design, implement, and develop internal systems for workshop repair order processing, work orders, maintenance logs, and spare parts inventory tracking to ensure complete data accuracy and operational traceability. Coordinate cross-functionally on various topics including Parts Inventory, Warranty, Operations, and corporate clients’ contracts to ensure smooth repair execution and seamless vehicle handovers. Support warranty processing, manufacturer recalls, and technical service bulletin executions in full alignment with operational guidelines. Address customer complaints, manage operational escalations, and execute service recovery actions to ensure high client satisfaction and minimize service disputes. Coach, mentor, and evaluate technical staff’s performance through identifying skill gaps, conducting performance appraisals, and delivering technical training to build departmental capability. Prepare, analyze, and submit daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports covering workshop revenue, cost savings, labor efficiency, inventory levels, and KPI metrics for executive review. Ensure all maintenance and repairs strictly comply with OEM (manufacturer) standards, technical specifications, and company SOPs. Oversee the full purchasing cycle for requisitions of automotive spare parts, tools, accessories, and workshop consumables. Manage and review the income and outcome of the warehouse in a timely manner in alignment with the PO and relevant services, and technicians' requests. Audit and assess the internal process starting from issuing the job order until handing over the vehicle to the client, ensuring professionalism and maintaining quality standards. Guide and support the team in advanced diagnosis, complex mechanical/electrical troubleshooting, and difficult repair procedures. Oversee real-time job status updates in the Workshop Management System (DMS) to track vehicle downtime and prompt turnaround and maintain live progress data. Monitor parts inventory levels across branch workshops to prevent stock out while optimizing inventory holding costs and stock turnover ratios. Dispatch and supervise mobile recovery units during emergency roadside breakdown situations. Escalate major operational disruptions, unresolvable technical issues, or significant financial variances promptly to upper management. Enforce strict compliance with Integrated Management System (IMS) standards—including ISO 9001 (Quality), ISO 14001 (Environment), and ISO 45001 (OH&S)—across all workshops and Bodyshop operations. Identify, report, and exercise authority to stop unsafe acts, hazardous working conditions, equipment defects, or operational non-conformities immediately. Participate actively in IMS internal audits, mandatory safety toolbox talks, HSE training, and quality improvement initiatives.
